purpose: Teach: バリー/メアリー/ラッセル/ジェリー/エド/エドワード/ブラッド/アニー

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがバリー・マニロウのコンサート映像を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is watching a Barry Manilow concert film right now.
lines.style: Gentle, observational tone. Speaking as if sharing a small domestic detail. Soft warmth — noticing what her husband is doing, inviting Sho into the moment. Steady pace, no urgency.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとメアリー・ポピンズの映画観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched Mary Poppins with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, eager burst. Quick pace. Leaning forward slightly with the energy of wanting to share something good. Open-mouthed on the excitement. No doubt — just pure reporting of something that mattered.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがラッセル卿の伝記を読んでらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is reading a biography of Bertrand Russell at the moment.
lines.style: Gentle, thoughtful. Speaking with mild bemusement at the specificity of what her husband chooses. Warm but observant — she sees the pattern. Slightly slower pace, reflective air.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとトムとジェリーのDVD観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched Tom and Jerry with Dad on DVD!
lines.style: Energetic and bright again. Quick delivery. The excitement of the repetition — he has something to share back, and it matters. Slight breathiness from eagerness. Open and unguarded.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがエド・シーランの新譜を流してらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is playing Ed Sheeran's new album right now.
lines.style: Warm observation with a thread of gentle amusement running underneath. Noticing another detail in the day. Steady, unhurried pace. The tone of someone cataloguing the small joys of her family.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとエドワード・ホッパーの画集観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I looked at Edward Hopper paintings with Dad!
lines.style: High brightness, quick attack. Eager to match the energy of sharing. Slight stretch on the word 'Hopper' — relishing the sophistication of what he experienced. Unself-conscious pride.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがブラッド・ピット主演の戦争映画を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is watching a war film with Brad Pitt in it.
lines.style: Softly observant. A note of gentle amusement at the contrast building in the pattern. Even pacing, warm undertone. She's noticing — and she's letting him see that she notices. No judgment, only affection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと「アニー」のミュージカル劇場で観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I saw the Annie musical at the theater with Dad!
lines.style: Joyful crescendo. Bright, triumphant tone. The pinnacle of his sharing — 'theater' landing with special weight. Open, energetic delivery. The victory in his voice of having experienced something live and real with his dad.
